title: Pick a class: Templar
caption: New character now offers the Templar after the Assassin, the Ranger, the Gladiator and the Spiritmaster.

title: A Templar at level 22
caption: A Templar character gets its own guide: Judgment first, Taunt for stigma slot 1, each with its game icon.

title: Skills that fire on a condition
caption: The Build plan says which five Templar skills fire only on a condition, such as Judgment right after a shield skill.

title: Templar stats and keys
caption: The Build tab shows Block, Defense and HP from Metabot, plus the game's default Q and E keys from your Templar screen.
